dedupe_keys.name: h2 simnet hydrogen blend transport network anomaly dataset

description: H2-SimNet provides simulated pressure and mass-flow series for hydrogen-blend networks, with labelled leaks, compressor faults, startup delays and overlapping anomalies. It includes original MATLAB and Simscape model files. The provider is Senese, Andrea; Acampora, Giovanni; De Vito, Saverio; di francia, girolamo; Esposito, Elena; LONGOBARDI, Antonia; monteleone, giulia; Villari, Michele. Coverage: The scenarios cover ramp-up, transient and steady operation. No real geographic network or calendar period is claimed; the time step is not stated in the abstract. Access: The provider publishes a metadata page describing the resource and its access route. Resource files were not downloaded or executed. Licence and cost: The deposit states a CC-BY-4.0 licence. Access is marked open. Limitations: The signal uncertainty uses added Gaussian noise. Synthetic anomaly labels and provider-stated use cases do not establish detection performance on operating infrastructure. For simulation it supports anomaly-detection, sensor-placement and condition-monitoring experiments. Related resources: For comparison, model-pandapipes provides pipe-network modelling. This is a thematic link, not evidence of use in this study.
